    if p is None: return None, None
    n=len(ids); i=n-1
    while i-p>=0 and ids[i]==ids[i-p]: i-=1
    return i+1, p
ons = [onset_period(ids) if m[3] else (None,None) for ids,m in zip(allids, meta_s)]
